messages:

Subject: LedgerLens governance pilot — proposal and next steps

Liz — thanks again for the demo last week. LedgerLens has been a solid fit for our cost-governance use case in the pilot; the team is keen to understand renewal economics and platform gaps before we commit to another year.

Can you send the latest proposal with:
- recommended commit tiers for 12/24 months
- expected token/ingestion pricing and any hidden fees (data exports, org seats)
- a short note on SSO/SAML support and data retention defaults

Cc'ing Laura (finops lead) and Karthik (procurement) for a quick read. Ideally we want a trimmed proposal + pricing workbook by end of week so procurement can start contract review.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Liz Harrow <liz@ledgerlens.com>

Cc: sales@ledgerlens.com, contracts@ledgerlens.com
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 14:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerLens governance pilot — proposal and next steps

Hi Marissa — appreciate the clear list. Attaching an updated proposal and pricing workbook for Redwood's usage profile. Summary highlights below: 
- Recommended: 12-month committed plan with blended token pricing that reduces unit cost by ~22% vs month-to-month.
- Included: SSO (SAML), role-based access, 13 months of default retention (options for archive).
- Optional: add-on for streaming visibility and custom alerts (itemized in pricing workbook).

Attachment: LedgerLens_proposal_v2.pdf (proposal, 10 pages)
Attachment: LedgerLens_pricing_2026Q3.xlsx (detailed workbook)

If helpful, I can schedule Contracts call to go line-by-line. We can also build a short mutual action plan (MAP) for signatures and onboarding.

Best,
Liz Harrow
Head of Sales Operations, LedgerLens
liz@ledgerlens.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: LedgerLens governance pilot — proposal and next steps

Forwarding LedgerLens proposal/workbook — see attachments. Quick notes:
- Vendor suggests 12-month commit as baseline; pricing workbook shows our current ingestion profile and a proposed blended rate.
- We need procurement to confirm SSO, retention, and whether the optional streaming visibility is worth adding for alerts.
- Laura: can you flag any data egress or export costs we should be wary of?
- Karthik: can you drive the contract questionnaire and let me know if we should ask for a limited security exception for the onboarding window?

Proposed next steps: procurement review -> contracts redlines -> pilot wrap sign-off by June 25 if commercially acceptable.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: LedgerLens proposal and pricing workbook (procurement checklist attached)

Thanks for the forward. I reviewed the proposal at a high level — looks reasonable but need answers on the items below before legal will accept standard terms: 
1) Security/compliance: Do you have SOC 2 Type II report and AICPA attestation? Please request vendor to provide the most recent report and gap plan if any controls are not in scope.
2) Data residency & retention: confirm whether retention is configurable per org and whether we can set auto-purge at 90/365 days.
3) Access & auth: SAML + SCIM provisioning supported? If SCIM is not available, we need an alternate provisioning flow documented.
4) SLA and uptime credits: vendor lists a 99.5% SLA in the workbook — procurement prefers 99.9% for production inference pipelines. Is there an escalation route in the contract?
5) Pricing: request a firm all-in rate with explicit line for exports/backups. The workbook has a few ambiguous rows — ask for a clarified 'all-in monthly TCO' for our 1.5TB/month ingest profile.

Attachment: redwood_procurement_checklist.xlsx (procurement checklist; includes minimum security and commercial asks)

I'll draft a short questionnaire for Liz and Contracts and can take point on the redlines if the answers are satisfactory.

-Karthik
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Liz Harrow <liz@ledgerlens.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@ledgerlens.com
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement questions + updated MAP (DocuSign link included)

Hi Karthik / Marissa — thanks, good questions. Quick responses inline: 
- SOC 2 Type II: yes — I attached the cover letter and we can provide the full report under NDA.
- Retention: configurable per org; default 13 months, can set auto-purge to 90/365 on request (we'll update config during onboarding).
- Auth: SAML + SCIM supported for orgs on committed plans; for short-term pilot we can do SAML + manual provisioning.
- SLA: we can revise to 99.9% for production with a defined uptime credit schedule; will need to reflect in SOW.
- Pricing: I've added an "all-in monthly TCO" sheet to the workbook and highlighted export/backup lines.

Contracts link for signature: https://app.docusign.com/doc/AB1234567890-LedgerLens-Quote
HubSpot deal id: deal_8472

I'll loop Contracts to prepare a 12-month statement of work with the 99.9% SLA and SAML/SCIM on the committed plan. If you want, we can push for a 5% discount milestone at signature to accelerate the cycle.

Best,
Liz Harrow
Head of Sales Operations, LedgerLens
